notes:
02: no remote metadata fetch anywhere; title/description entered manually, no favicon/preview collection. 03: title/description editable before/after save, but nothing is auto-collected to edit. 04: edits url/title/description/tags but there is no separate markdown note field. 06: duplicate url is detected and a warning dialog shown, but it offers 'Save duplicate' (creates another copy) rather than converging to editing the existing bookmark. 07: shows title/description/tags but uses a first-letter monogram, no real favicon. 10: tag field is a plain comma-separated text input, no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. 12: note field absent (description searched instead), otherwise full-text over title/url/description/tags. 14: '#tag' not parsed; tags stored without '#' so '#x' substring never matches. 15: search is plain substring only, no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling; quotes searched literally. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag in model or UI. 20-21: no multi-select or filter-wide bulk actions. 22: list is hard-coded newest-first (one date-added key), no user-selectable sort key. 23: description rendered as plain

, no markdown note. 24-25: no snapshot/PDF/Internet Archive functionality. 26-28: no archive state or archived view. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
